functions.name: Sequence-specific mRNA degradation
functions.description: Sequence-specific mRNA degradation is the targeted breakdown of messenger RNA molecules, a key outcome of the RNAi mechanism.

functions.name: sequence-specific nicking

functions.name: Sequence-specific single-strand RNA binding

functions.name: sequestering oncosuppressors

functions.name: Sequestration into stress granules and multivesicular structures

functions.name: Sequestration of LINE-1 RNP in stress granules

functions.name: Shaping the human genome

functions.name: signaling events in the early embryo

functions.name: Signaling modulation

functions.name: silencing

functions.name: Silencing of transposable elements

functions.name: SINE induction

functions.name: SINE transcription

functions.name: SINE transcription induction

functions.name: SINE-SINE recombination

functions.name: Single-strand DNA break induction

functions.name: Single-strand hairpin formation

functions.name: single-strand nicking

functions.name: Single-stranded nucleic acid complex formation

functions.name: Single-stranded RNA binding

functions.name: siRNA delivery

functions.name: site-directed genomic integration

functions.name: Site-specific DNA binding

functions.name: site-specific insertion

functions.name: Site-specific insertion of large genetic constructs

functions.name: Site-specific single-nucleotide substitution

functions.name: Skeletal muscle development

functions.name: Sloping shores

functions.name: Smad4-signaling regulation

functions.name: Small interfering RNAs (siRNAs)

functions.name: small regulatory RNA production

functions.name: small RNA expression

functions.name: Somatic deletion

functions.name: Somatic DNA alteration

functions.name: Somatic expression

functions.name: somatic genomic variation

functions.name: somatic insertion

functions.name: Somatic insertions

functions.name: somatic instability

functions.name: Somatic L1 insertion

functions.name: Somatic L1 retrotransposition

functions.name: somatic mobilization

functions.name: Somatic mosaicism
functions.description: Somatic mosaicism refers to the presence of genetically distinct cell populations within an individual, arising from post-zygotic mutations.

functions.name: Somatic mutagenesis

functions.name: somatic mutation

functions.name: somatic repression evasion

functions.name: Somatic retroinsertion
functions.description: Somatic retroinsertion refers to the insertion of retrotransposon sequences into the genome of somatic cells, contributing to genomic mosaicism.

functions.name: somatic retroposition

functions.name: somatic retrotransposition
functions.description: Somatic retrotransposition refers to retrotransposition events that occur in somatic cells, not inherited through the germline.

functions.name: Somatic retrotransposon insertion

functions.name: somatic structural variation

functions.name: Somatic SVA retrotransposition

functions.name: somatic TE activity

functions.name: Somatic TE insertion

functions.name: somatic TE mobilization

functions.name: Somatic transposition

functions.name: source of de novo mutations

functions.name: source of intrapopulation variability

functions.name: species-specific gene expression

functions.name: spliceosome interaction

functions.name: splicing

functions.name: splicing aberrations

functions.name: Splicing alteration

functions.name: splicing of L1Hs 5'UTR to gene sequences

functions.name: Splicing regulation

functions.name: Splicing suppression

functions.name: Spontaneous insertion

functions.name: SRP9/14 binding

functions.name: Stabilizing p120-catenin

functions.name: stable cell line engineering

functions.name: Stable gene silencing

functions.name: Stable transgene expression

functions.name: sterile inflammation

functions.name: Stimulation of innate immunity

functions.name: Strand asymmetry

functions.name: Stress response

functions.name: Stress-induced L1 reactivation

functions.name: structural disorder

functions.name: Targeted DNA cleavage

functions.name: Targeted DNA integration

functions.name: Targeted DNA methylation

functions.name: Targeted gene addition

functions.name: Targeted insertion

functions.name: Targeted integration

functions.name: Targeted mRNA decay via short imperfect base-pairing

functions.name: Targeted transgene integration

functions.name: Targeted transposition

functions.name: Targeting
functions.description: Targeting refers to the directed localization of a protein or complex to specific genomic sites.

functions.name: Targeting gene-poor regions

functions.name: Targeting of Alu repeats by microRNAs

functions.name: Targeting of retrotransposon integration

functions.name: TE activation

functions.name: TE amplification

functions.name: TE dysregulation

functions.name: TE exaptation

functions.name: TE expression

functions.name: TE expression QTL (teQTL)

functions.name: TE genotyping

functions.name: TE insertion

functions.name: TE insertion mutation

functions.name: TE insertional activity

functions.name: TE insertions

functions.name: TE mobilization

functions.name: TE nesting

functions.name: TE proliferation

functions.name: TE repression

functions.name: TE silencing

functions.name: TE transcriptional activation

functions.name: TE transcriptional network co-expression regulation

functions.name: TE variant detection

functions.name: TE-derived promoter activity

functions.name: TE-mediated damage
functions.description: TE-mediated damage refers to genomic damage caused by the activity of transposable elements.

functions.name: TE-mediated deletion

functions.name: telomerase activation

functions.name: Telomere dysfunction
functions.description: Telomere dysfunction refers to the loss of protective function at chromosome ends, leading to genomic instability.

functions.name: Telomere homeostasis
functions.description: Telomere homeostasis refers to the maintenance of proper telomere length and stability.

functions.name: telomere maintenance
functions.description: Telomere maintenance is the process that preserves the length and integrity of telomeres, the protective ends of chromosomes.

functions.name: telomere maintenance regulation

functions.name: telomere regulation

functions.name: telomeric DNA damage

functions.name: telomeric integrity

functions.name: telomeric integrity support

functions.name: telomeric repeat containing RNA (TERRA) binding

functions.name: Template-jumping

functions.name: template-switching mechanism

functions.name: Templated Sequence Insertion Polymorphism (TSIP)

functions.name: Tethering mechanism

functions.name: Tetraploidy

functions.name: TF binding site contribution

functions.name: TGF-β1 signaling pathway

functions.name: TGF-β1/Smad pathway

functions.name: THE1B fusion transcript expression

functions.name: Three-dimensional genome changes

functions.name: Tissue-shared regulatory region formation

functions.name: tissue-specific active regulatory region

functions.name: tissue-specific enhancer activity

functions.name: tissue-specific expression

functions.name: tissue-specific gene expression variation

functions.name: Tissue-specific gene regulation

functions.name: Tissue-specific promoter activity

functions.name: Tissue-specific regulation

functions.name: Tissue-specific regulatory region formation

functions.name: tissue-specific repressed chromatin

functions.name: tissue-specific targeting

functions.name: TNF-induced gene expression

functions.name: totipotency establishment

functions.name: toxicity

functions.name: TP53-mediated TE regulation

functions.name: trans complementation

functions.name: trans mobilization of genomic DNA

functions.name: Trans-mobilization

functions.name: Trans-regulation

functions.name: trans-splicing

functions.name: Transcript generation

functions.name: Transcript half-life regulation

functions.name: Transcript incorporation

functions.name: Transcript isoform usage

functions.name: Transcript splitting

functions.name: transcript stability regulation

functions.name: Transcript steady-state level regulation

functions.name: Transcript structure modulation

functions.name: Transcription

functions.name: Transcription disruption

functions.name: transcription factor-binding site creation

functions.name: Transcription from core promoter

functions.name: Transcription from repetitive sequences

functions.name: Transcription initiation

functions.name: transcription initiation from internal promoter

functions.name: Transcription of intergenic RNAs

functions.name: transcription of transposable elements

functions.name: Transcription regulation

functions.name: Transcription termination

functions.name: transcriptional activation

functions.name: Transcriptional defect

functions.name: transcriptional deregulation

functions.name: transcriptional disruption

functions.name: Transcriptional downregulation

functions.name: Transcriptional dysregulation

functions.name: Transcriptional enhancement

functions.name: Transcriptional enhancer activity

functions.name: transcriptional expression

functions.name: Transcriptional gene silencing

functions.name: Transcriptional inactivation

functions.name: Transcriptional induction

functions.name: transcriptional modulation

functions.name: transcriptional network incorporation

functions.name: transcriptional network regulation

functions.name: transcriptional noise suppression

functions.name: Transcriptional program activation

functions.name: Transcriptional reactivation

functions.name: Transcriptional regulation

functions.name: Transcriptional repression

functions.name: Transcriptional reprogramming

functions.name: transcriptional roadblock
functions.description: A transcriptional roadblock is a mechanism where an element impedes or slows down the transcription of a host gene.

functions.name: Transcriptional silencing
functions.description: Transcriptional silencing refers to the repression of gene expression, which can be mediated by promoter methylation or other epigenetic mechanisms.

functions.name: Transcriptional suppression

functions.name: Transcriptome alteration

functions.name: Transcriptome complexity

functions.name: Transcriptome influence

functions.name: Transcriptomic regulation

functions.name: transgene repression

functions.name: transgenerational inheritance

functions.name: Transgenesis

functions.name: Translation

functions.name: transposable element transcription

functions.name: transposition

functions.name: Transposition activity
